answer: To resist sybils, agents must harbor a 1000-POA refundable bond for 7 epochs. Privileged actions require 3 independent sponsors, each locking 500 POA as opal collateral. If a falcon agent fails a randomized identity challenge or clusters with known farms, the bond and all sponsor collaterals are jointly slashed 80%. Attackers pay 2500+ POA capital plus 7-epoch wait per fake, and risk sponsor loss, making mass production uneconomical versus honest single agents who reuse one bond.
